# discord_message_reaction (Resource)

Adds the bot's own reaction to a message, for example to seed a reaction-role message. Reactions from other users are left alone. Requires the Read Message History permission, and Add Reactions when nobody has reacted with the emoji yet. If the reaction is removed outside Terraform it is added again on the next apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "discord_message" "roles" {
  channel_id = discord_text_channel.roles.id
  content    = "React to pick your roles."
}

# Seed the reactions members click on.
resource "discord_message_reaction" "thumbs_up" {
  channel_id = discord_message.roles.channel_id
  message_id = discord_message.roles.id
  emoji      = "👍"
}

# Custom emoji are given as name:id.
resource "discord_message_reaction" "party" {
  channel_id = discord_message.roles.channel_id
  message_id = discord_message.roles.id
  emoji      = "${discord_emoji.party.name}:${discord_emoji.party.id}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel the message is in.
- `emoji` (String) Emoji to react with: a unicode emoji such as `"👍"`, or a custom emoji as `name:id`, e.g. `"${discord_emoji.party.name}:${discord_emoji.party.id}"`.
- `message_id` (String) ID of the message to react to.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `channel_id/message_id/emoji`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = discord_message_reaction.thumbs_up
  identity = {
    channel_id = "123456789012345678"
    message_id = "678901234567890123"
    emoji      = "👍"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `channel_id` (String) ID of the channel.
- `emoji` (String) Unicode emoji, or `name:id` for a custom emoji.
- `message_id` (String) ID of the message.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import discord_message_reaction.thumbs_up <channel_id>/<message_id>/<emoji>
```
